purpose: Searches the catalogue's human languages by name, and finds the one entry for a stored language tag.
namedChanges: `LANGUAGE_ENTITY` (a RegExp built from the origin constant when the file loads) becomes `languageEntityPattern()`, built from `termOrigin()` at each call (STOP-7). A test pins that it refuses the same path on a foreign origin.
The catalogue origin and the vault id come from `termOrigin()` (unit `term-origin`) in place of the source's constants; the vault id is the two own lines `${termOrigin()}/base`.
`searchLanguagesRemote` builds the pattern once per call and tests each hit with it.
